changes.summary: Run one scenario against an existing snapshot, optionally over a materialized snapshot copy or a digest-pinned local OCI container. The default workspace mode stays trusted-native and is recorded as isolated=false.

sandbox.include: relative POSIX file or directory prefixes; non-empty for workspace_copy and container
sandbox.image: container only; name@sha256:... or a local sha256:<id>, verified against the local image and never pulled
sandbox.cwd: relative cwd inside the snapshot copy; defaults to its root

behavior.snapshot_source: the ledger CAS for the declared snapshot; the live workspace is never read in a sandboxed mode
behavior.copy_lifecycle: removed after succeeded; retained with retained=true for every other completion
behavior.container: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=64m --security-opt no-new-privileges --pull never, copy bind-mounted at /workspace
behavior.cleanup: docker rm -f by name after success, timeout and cancellation; sandbox.container.removed records the outcome
behavior.environment: host allowlist for the docker client; target values via -e and redacted in sandbox.exec_argv, only names in env_names
refusals: empty include for workspace_copy or container

limitation: Docker/Linux only, image must be provisioned locally, container process is outside the host process audit, no CPU/memory limits
